title: Fix the Grade Calculator
description: The program should assign letter grades: 90+ is A, 80+ is B, 70+ is C, otherwise F. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: A score of 95 should be graded 'A'.
actualProblem: The conditions are checked from lowest to highest threshold, so a score of 95 satisfies score >= 70 first and is incorrectly graded 'C' — the later, more specific branches never get a chance to run.
explanation: An if/elif chain stops at the first condition that is true. Range checks like this must be ordered from most restrictive (highest threshold) to least restrictive so a high score doesn't get caught by an earlier, looser condition.
